title: Sound in two-path tube networks: the smallest length l for which the detector hears a maximum, matched to List-II
summary: Sound of wavelength 0.29 m splits between a straight tube of length l and a detour in four tube networks. The detector hears the first maximum when the path difference is one wavelength: l = 0.51, 0.29, 0.13 and 1.19 m for P, Q, R and S - option D.
subject: Physics
topic: Interference of sound along two paths in tube networks - the smallest length for a maximum at the detector
subtopics: Superposition of two waves from one source: amplitude |1 + e^(i 2 pi Delta/lambda)|
Constructive interference: path difference Delta = m lambda
Path lengths of semicircles, rectangles and triangles (sine rule) in units of l
Smallest length: l_min = lambda/(k - 1) for a detour of k l
concepts: The sound splits at S and recombines at D, so only the path difference matters: a maximum needs Delta = m lambda, the smallest non-zero l has Delta = lambda
Every length in a figure scales with l, so the detour is k l and l_min = lambda/(k - 1)
k = pi/2 (semicircle on l), 2 (rectangle of height l/2), 1 + pi/sqrt2 (side l plus a semicircle on the diagonal), (sin 30 + sin 45)/cos 15 (triangle by the sine rule)
l = 0.508, 0.290, 0.131, 1.186 m -> (3), (4), (5), (2): option D; with the exact cos 15 the triangle gives 1.16 m, still nearest (2)
formulas: Delta = (k - 1) l = lambda for the first maximum
k_P = pi/2, k_Q = 2, k_R = 1 + pi/sqrt2, k_S = (sin 30 + sin 45)/sin 105
answerValue: P->3, Q->4, R->5, S->2 (option D; key D)

derivedQuantities.l_S: 1.186 m (1.161 m with the exact cos 15)

methods: Solved independently: detour factors pi/2, 2, 1 + pi/sqrt2 and (0.5 + 0.7071)/0.97; l = 0.29/(k - 1) = 0.508, 0.290, 0.131, 1.186 m; nearest List-II (3), (4), (5), (2) -> option D
sympy: each detour as a multiple of l and the first maximum at Delta = lambda

Geometry from coordinates: each network built as points (arcs sampled, the triangle from its angles by intersecting the two sides), path lengths measured, the two waves added as phasors and the first maximum of |1 + e^(i phi)| found by sweeping l
Every option audited: A, B and C each fail on at least one row
The page engine extracted and run in Node: first maxima to 1e-6 m, map P3 Q4 R5 S2, answer D
